cohort: 318 mothers admitted to the Maternity ward or delivered from the Maternity ward at St. Joseph's Hospital, Kitovu.
finding: The Caesarean section rate at St. Joseph's Hospital, Kitovu was 47.6%, with significant determinants including age less than 20 years, not being married, lower educational level, living in an urban setting, and socioeconomic factors such as regular household income and occupation.
